{{Quote|Stark has agreed to meet us on ''Troiken'', a planet in the Outer Rim.|[[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]|<ref name="SW36">[[Star Wars (1998) 36|''Star Wars'' (1998) 36]]</ref>}}
The '''Troiken system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Colundra sector/Legends|Colundra sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]].<ref name="SoT" />
